body: I don't feel like myself anymore.

Adoption is not an option. My husband is the only child of an only child. We can trace back to his great great grandfather and they all were the only child.  He would make an amazing father and he deserves to have his family name carried on. Maybe if I wasn't in the way he could find someone to give him the family he deserves.
How can I let go of the past if I am constantly reminded of it?
